chunks: And it has been narrated, concerning bandages, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْجَبَائِرِ: bandages or splints placed over an injured area
key_terms.مَا حَوْلَهَا: that which is around it, meaning the area surrounding the bandage
key_terms.يَغْسِلُ: he washes as part of ritual purification

ai.seo_question: What should be washed in wudu (ablution) when there is a bandage on the limb?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding bandages in the context of ritual purification. It indicates that when a bandaged area cannot be washed directly, one should wash the surrounding area.
